example_sentences_in_bangla: অফিসে তার চাঁদমারি চলছে সবার কাছ থেকে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone has made me the target of ridicule and attack.
He's facing universal criticism from everyone at the office.
note: The idiom evokes the image of everyone collectively targeting something unattainable like the moon, symbolizing universal opposition.
